scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:calc
scripts.lint:calc: python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:calc
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:calc && npm run test:artefacts
scripts.test:calc: cd services/calculation && python -m unittest discover -s tests
